name: Permanent Best
description: Permanently paints your saved best onto the progress bar, flashes when you pass it, and adds a separate Gold Speedrun mode for platformer levels.

issues.info: Include your newest Geode log when reporting a problem.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for Permanent Best and Gold Speedrun.

show-gold-fill.name: Show Permanent Gold Bar
show-gold-fill.description: Paint the saved best directly onto the active progress bar. Once you touch the old best, the gold fill follows the current run.

completed-level-full-gold.name: Completed Levels Stay Gold
completed-level-full-gold.description: Keep the entire progress bar gold on normal levels that you have completed.

show-marker.name: Show Best Marker
show-marker.description: Show a permanent gold marker at the saved best percentage.

show-best-label.name: Show Best Text
show-best-label.description: Show BEST percentage or normal platformer best time below the progress bar.

gold-current-label.name: Gold While Passing Best
gold-current-label.description: Turn the current percentage or normal platformer timer gold while it is ahead of the saved best.

gold-flash.name: Gold Screen Flash
gold-flash.description: Show a short gold flash when the old best is reached or a new time is saved.

gold-shine.name: Gold Shine Sweep
gold-shine.description: Sweep a bright gold-white shine across the screen when a record is reached.

pulse-label.name: Pulse Best Text
pulse-label.description: Briefly pulse the BEST text when a record is reached.

platformer-mode.name: Normal Platformer Best Timer
platformer-mode.description: Track the fastest platformer completion time outside Gold Speedrun mode.

gold-speedrun-mode.name: Gold Speedrun Mode
gold-speedrun-mode.description: Enable the separate platformer-only speedrun mode with its own records, failures, timer, and Golden Best.

show-speedrun-button.name: Show Pause-Menu Speedrun Button
show-speedrun-button.description: Show the gold practice-style button in the lower-right of the pause menu. It appears locked on non-platformer levels.

show-speedrun-timer.name: Show Gold Speedrun HUD
show-speedrun-timer.description: Show the Gold Speedrun timer, Golden Best, run count, finishes, and failures near the top-right.

save-run-history.name: Save Gold Run History
save-run-history.description: Save the newest 20 Gold Speedrun completions and failures separately for every platformer level.

practice-mode.name: Show in Practice Mode
practice-mode.description: Display normal saved-best visuals in practice mode. Practice attempts never overwrite records.

test-mode.name: Show in Start Position/Test Mode
test-mode.description: Display normal saved-best visuals during editor test or start-position attempts. Test attempts never overwrite records.

best-color.name: Gold Color
best-color.description: Color used for the permanent bar, marker, Golden Best timer, labels, and flash.
